name: print-social-novavista-fashion-updates-post-with-outline-echo-headline
title: Cream 'Be the first to know about the latest fashion updates!' post with outline-echo headline and ruled grid
whatItIs: A square cream post with a bold black uppercase headline over faint outlined repeats of the same text, two close-up photos (watch and rings, green drop pendant) in a thin ruled grid, an arrow icon, justified body copy and a footer row with 'N' logo, 'Our latest catalogue' and URL.
whatItMeans: Refined and editorial; the ruled grid and outline echo feel like a modern lookbook.
techniques: Echo the headline in faint outline type behind it.
Lay out content in a thin ruled grid.
Use a footer row as a mini nav bar.
Show accessory close-ups instead of full looks.

vocabulary.definition: Repeated outline text behind a solid headline.
A collection of photos showing a fashion line.
